Usage: cli decode [OPTIONS] IMAGE_PATH

Options:
  -op, --output-path TEXT   Output folder to save the message text.  [default:
                            (current path)]
  -mn, --message-name TEXT  Name of the message text file to save into the
                            output path.  [default: (<image_name>-message)]
  -sm, --save-message       Save the extracted message into a file into the
                            specified output path.
  -d, --decrypt             Decrypt the hidden message.
  --help                    Show this message and exit.
